verdict.rationale: Crossplane's docs say it installs into your own existing Kubernetes cluster with a standard Helm chart, so you run the core control plane on your own infrastructure. A community comment confirms it runs in a user-managed cluster, but notes you must provision that cluster yourself. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license or self-hosting terms in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install, and any built-in bootstrapping of the underlying Kubernetes cluster.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Crossplane installs into an existing Kubernetes cluster, creating the Crossplane pod.
Install Crossplane using the Helm chart.
